action.prompt: Before implementing this spec task: (1) list the requirement IDs and correctness properties it covers, (2) confirm you are on a feature branch (feat/<spec-name>), not main, (3) write or extend the failing unit tests and the Hypothesis property test for every correctness property touched (tests/property/test_<spec>_properties.py), then implement. Follow python-standards.md and testing-standards.md.

Spec task finished. Run `uv run ruff check --fix .`, `uv run pyrefly check` and `uv run pytest -m "not aws and not integration" -q`. Fix any failure before marking the task complete. Then propose ONE Conventional Commit message for this task using the conventional-commit skill, including trailers Spec:, Task:, Refs: with the requirement IDs. Update docs/LESSON_MAP.md if this task demonstrates a Kiro lesson.
